subject: Post-call: Redwood procurement & security next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Sophie Chen <sophie.chen@acme.com>, Rajiv Patel <rajiv.patel@acme.com>
Cc: procurement@acme.com
Date: Wed, 05 May 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call: Redwood procurement & security next steps

Hi Sophie / Rajiv -

Thanks again for the time today - great conversation and appreciate the transparency on procurement and security gating. Quick recap + proposed next steps so we stay aligned: 

1) Recap from today
- Use case: ACME search assistant + customer support summarization (initial prod workloads ~10M tokens/month).
- Desired SLOs: 100ms p95 on short queries, burst to cover peak demo loads.
- Primary blocker: procurement & security approvals (SOC 2 / DPA / vendor questionnaire).

2) Procurement path question (important for our legal/finance planning)
- Do you prefer to do a PO for the initial year or pay by card?
- If PO: who will own the PO (billing/procurement contact)? You mentioned procurement@acme.com - can you confirm the name and typical lead time?
- Marketplace interest: we can also list Redwood on your cloud marketplace to accelerate procurement if that helps (avoids PO in some cases).

3) Security/compliance handoff
- Attached: redacted SOC 2 Type II (summary), and a DPA draft for your legal team to review.
- If you have a vendor security questionnaire, please send the link (or upload to OneTrust) and we'll assign our security lead to fill it out.

4) Proposed next steps
- Sophie / Rajiv: confirm procurement path (PO vs card) and expected timeline.
- Sophie: share any vendor questionnaire link and the primary legal contact for the DPA.
- We'll circulate the redacted SOC 2 and DPA draft (attached) and have our security engineer looped in for any follow-ups.

If it helps, I'm happy to set a quick 20-min alignment call with your procurement + security to speed things up.

Thanks - talk soon.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0198
Redwood Inference

Attachments: Redwood_SOC2_TypeII_redacted.pdf (summary), Redwood_DPA_Draft_v1.docx

From: Sophie Chen <sophie.chen@acme.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Rajiv Patel <rajiv.patel@acme.com>, procurement@acme.com
Date: Wed, 05 May 2027 16:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call: Redwood procurement & security next steps

Thanks Marissa - really helpful summary. A few data points from procurement side: 

- Procurement preference: For vendor spend over $50k/year, we typically do a PO (standard path). For small pilots under $50k we usually use corporate card.
- Lead time: PO path historically 4-6 weeks once legal signs commercial terms; if Marketplace is used we can sometimes shorten to 1-2 weeks.
- Procurement owner: Rajiv Patel (cc'd) will own the PO and intake.
- Vendor questionnaire: Please upload your SOC/DPA answers to OneTrust or send to vendor_security@acme.com - our security team will triage.

Quick asks: Can you confirm SOC 2 is Type II (covers last 12 months) and whether you provide evidence for audit logs retention / encryption-at-rest? Also share a DPA for initial review and we'll route to legal.

Appreciate the quick turnaround.

- Sophie
Sophie Chen
Senior Product Manager, AI Integrations | Acme Corp

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Sophie Chen <sophie.chen@acme.com>, Rajiv Patel <rajiv.patel@acme.com>
Cc: procurement@acme.com, dev.patel@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 06 May 2027 09:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call: Redwood procurement & security next steps

Sophie - thanks, really helpful. Quick answers and next steps below.

Answers: 
- SOC 2: Yes, Redwood maintains a SOC 2 Type II covering the prior 12 months (report is attached; redacted for customer distribution).
- Audit logs / retention / encryption: We retain audit logs for 1 year by default; configurable retention is available on Dedicated/Private deployments. All data at rest is encrypted (AES-256) and in transit is TLS 1.2+.

Attachments included: Redwood_SOC2_TypeII_redacted.pdf, Redwood_DPA_Draft_v1.docx

Commercial path / timeline: 
- If ACME wants to go PO route: estimate 4-6 weeks to finalize commercial terms and PO issuance (legal review + signature).
- Card / pilot: we can provision demo/test access within 48 hours for a card payment or marketplace listing.
- Marketplace option: If you want we can start the marketplace onboarding in parallel; once approved it can reduce procurement friction.

Next steps proposed: 
1) Rajiv: confirm whether you want us to route the DPA to your legal or upload to your vendor portal.
2) Sophie: share OneTrust link (or vendor_security contact) if you want us to complete the questionnaire directly.
3) I'll loop in Dev (solutions engineering) to answer any technical questions from security/legal.

Would you like a 30-min joint session with procurement + security next week to run through the SOC 2 summary + DPA?

Thanks,
Marissa
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai

-----Original Attachment Stubs-----
- Redwood_SOC2_TypeII_redacted.pdf (PDF, 2.1MB redacted)
- Redwood_DPA_Draft_v1.docx (Word doc, 45KB)

From: Rajiv Patel <rajiv.patel@acme.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Sophie Chen <sophie.chen@acme.com>
Cc: procurement@acme.com, security@acme.com, legal@acme.com
Date: Thu, 06 May 2027 11:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call: Redwood procurement & security next steps

Marissa / Sophie - thanks for the docs. A couple clarifying items from security/legal: 

1) Can you confirm the SOC 2 report is Type II (you indicated yes) and the period covered? We need explicit period in the SOC 2 summary (e.g., Jan 1 2026 - Dec 31 2026).
2) For the DPA: does the DPA include subprocessor list and standard commercial indemnities? Our legal will want to review and may redline.
3) Logging: Can you confirm whether admin-level access logs and customer data access logs are retained for 12 months and whether they can be exported on request for audits?

If the answers are straightforward we can route this to legal for the DPA and continue with PO intake. Otherwise we may schedule a technical call with your security engineer.

Thanks,
Rajiv Patel
Procurement Lead | Acme Corp
procurement@acme.com

From: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>
To: Rajiv Patel <rajiv.patel@acme.com>, Sophie Chen <sophie.chen@acme.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, security@acme.com
Date: Fri, 07 May 2027 08:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call: Redwood procurement & security next steps

Hi Rajiv / Sophie - looping in quick answers from engineering/security: 

- SOC 2 period: The attached redacted report covers Jan 1 2026 - Dec 31 2026 (Type II). We can provide the cover letter for legal if needed.
- Logs: 
  - Admin-level and customer data access logs are retained for 12 months by default.
  - Logs can be exported as CSV/ELT on request; for Dedicated/Private customers we can set longer retention and push to your SIEM (S3/Cloudwatch/Logstash).
- Subprocessors: The DPA draft includes the current list of subprocessors; we can provide the full list and subscriptions URL to legal.

If you want a short technical session I can run through the audit logs and demo the export in 20-30 minutes. If legal wants to redline the DPA, we can accept edits via DocuSign or markups in the Word doc.

Marissa - happy to join any call next week.

Thanks,
Dev Patel
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
dev.patel@redwood.ai
